parameters.name: powerSql
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the Dedicated SQL feature. For more information, see [Enable Dedicated SQL](~~223777~~). Valid values:

*   true
*   false (default): enables the Standard SQL feature.

You can use the powerSql or **query** parameter to configure Dedicated SQL.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The standard SQL statement. In this example, the SQL statement queries the number of page views (PVs) from 2022-03-01 10:41:40 to 2022-03-01 10:56:40 in a Logstore whose name is nginx-moni.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls get-project-logs --project ali-test-project --query SELECT_COUNT_0_as_pv_FROM_nginx-moni_where_time_1646102500_and_time_1646103400 --power-sql false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sls GET /logs --project ali-test-project --region cn-hangzhou --powerSql false --query 'SELECT_COUNT_0_as_pv_FROM_nginx-moni_where_time_1646102500_and_time_1646103400' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
